import sys

def get(w, m):
    if m == 0:
        return True
    if m % w != 0:
        return False
    m = m // w
    if m == 1:
        return True
    return get(w, m) or get(w, m-1) or get(w, m+1)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    ans = get(w, m) or get(w, m-1) or get(w, m+1)
    print("YES" if ans else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
